$comment: Reviewed audience/applicability metadata. TRACKED AND HAND-MAINTAINED — unlike docs-meta.json, which is gitignored and regenerated by scripts/extract-meta.mjs on every build and therefore cannot hold anything written by a person. Frontmatter was the other candidate and was rejected: the corpus has none (site/src/content.config.ts records that it predates the site and the collection schema is deliberately empty), and scripts/md_to_speech.py has no frontmatter branch, so a YAML block READS ALOUD as the document's first spoken paragraph, ahead of the title. Measured on a probe, not assumed. ⚠️ NOTHING HERE MAY ASSERT A HOCKEY FACT, A RULE, A SAFETY CLAIM, AN AGE OR LEAGUE APPLICABILITY, OR A PREVALENCE CLAIM THAT HAS NOT BEEN REVIEWED. A field with status 'draft' has not been reviewed and must not be rendered as though it had.
generatedBy: hand — this file is the source of truth for the fields it carries

vocabularies.$comment: Controlled values. Adding one is a reviewed change, not a convenience. ⚠️ 'u10-safe' is deliberately absent and must never be added: safety is a property of a jurisdiction, a division, a contact rule and a supervision context, never of a document.

fieldPolicy.$comment: Which fields carry per-field provenance. The plan requires owner/reviewer/status/evidence/revalidateAfter wherever a field concerns age, league, safety, supervision or audio availability — because those are the ones that can hurt somebody if they are wrong or go stale.

audioContract.$comment: ⚠️ audioMinutes is NOT populated and should not be, from podcast.json's duration_s. Measured over all 37 episodes: every one runs 48.0-72.1 minutes and episode length is nearly independent of document length (Pearson r = 0.301; a document 22x longer yields an episode 1.27x longer). These are NotebookLM Audio Overviews — a conversation ABOUT the source, not a reading OF it — so the duration describes the production, not the text, and shortening a document will not shorten its episode. The release-one audio requirement is the UNIT CONTRACT instead: every required safety, rule-set, age, league or medical condition occurs in the same SPOKEN SENTENCE as its instruction, verified against the scripts/md_to_speech.py extraction. Sentence, not paragraph: _split_paragraph cuts oversized paragraphs at sentence boundaries across chunk edges.

safetyCritical.evidence: The document carries hard safety imperatives measured in wave 1: the ask-before-you-turn-up session warning, 'never shoot at a goaltender who is not ready', the second-hand-helmet rule stated five times, and the British neck-laceration-protector requirement stated four times. Marked true pending safety-reviewer confirmation; it is not a claim that the document is sufficient.

unclassified.$comment: ⚠️ EXPLICITLY UNCLASSIFIED, NOT OVERLOOKED. The plan bounds release one to the two pilots and the principles index and says to leave every other document explicitly unclassified rather than inferring labels, because an inferred age or league label is an unreviewed factual claim about a collision sport. A later wave may classify these under the same review requirements.
